servidor_vortex.histria.quests0.descript: &oHumans and Gods... none of them were able to predict that, that otherworldly thing. In a blink of the eyes, the universe was swolen by an vortex force faster than light itself.
servidor_vortex.histria.quests0.subtitle: And your crimes.
servidor_vortex.histria.quests0.title: The Vortex
servidor_vortex.histria.quests1.descript: &oA diamond... A memory of some other life, you remember this jewel. A feeling of nostalgia It sparks a vision like a flash... A face... A family... That’s what the Vortex stole from you—every achievement, every desire, every dream for the future. Do you think that’s fair? What is this Vortex, after all? An arbiter? A greater force?
&oYou let go of the memory and the distressing feeling of confusion, resolving to continue your journey.
servidor_vortex.histria.quests1.subtitle: Wake up!
servidor_vortex.histria.quests1.title: You
servidor_vortex.histria.quests3.descript: &oI am &eZeus&r&o and I shall be your guide, young sprit... We must reclaim the world to prevent that same heinous crime from ever happening again. Rise! Draw your sword and charge forth! Let us rid the world of these profane titans!
servidor_vortex.histria.quests3.title: Zeus
servidor_vortex.histria.quests4.descript: &oWhat's that? This place is already populated? What are these creatures obsessed with a simple emerald?! Whoever they are, they're in great danger. We need to find that Vortex, and fast! Search the area and try to get some information from these Villagers.
servidor_vortex.histria.quests4.title: Habitants?
